title_en: We’re Hosting a Two-Night Game with IGN Event at Dave & Buster’s in California - IGN
body_en:
Gaming is on the verge of the biggest release in its history, so we figured it was only right to celebrate with an appropriately epic party of our own. We’re hosting a special Game with IGN event over two nights at the Dave & Buster’s in Irvine, California , where you’ll be able to play games, compete to win several really cool prizes, and try some limited time themed cocktails.
It will take place November 20–21 from 6:00 p.m.–midnight on both nights. The first 100 guests to arrive each night will get a custom IGN x Dave & Buster’s Power Card pre-loaded with $20 worth of gameplay, letting you enjoy some games for free. And that’s just where the fun begins.
There will be competitions both nights, with the winners walking away with some incredible prizes, including PlayStation 5 consoles, gaming controllers, game codes, and more.
Plus, we’ll pick some lucky winners to get additional Dave & Buster’s Power Cards, Humble Bundle Subscriptions, and IGN Store Gift Cards. The prizes will be flowing freely across both nights in this celebration.
There will also be plenty of food and drinks available, which includes a unique menu of cocktails and mocktails. So bring your friends and come enjoy two nights of fun. And who knows, maybe you’ll walk away with some amazing prizes. We can’t wait to see you there!
Must be 18+ to participate
